AfterAddedToRoom.rationale: SHARED-FINDINGS section 2, copied not re-derived. The sim has no add-to-room phase - creature creation IS construction - so AfterAddedToRoom's effect is applied from __init__ (the_kin.py:39-42). Same observable today on all three clauses: (a) listener set - the only ported listeners on the hooks a starting power can reach are relics/ruined_helmet.py:23-38 and relics/unsettling_lamp.py:44-53 (modify_power_amount) and relics/vambrace.py:26-40 / relics/paels_legion.py:36-43 (modify_block_multiplicative); all four gate on `target is self.player` / `applier is self.player` / `card is not None`, and a monster's starting power is self-applied with no card, so none can fire, and sts2_rl/potions.py implements none of the four hooks; (b) HP-roll inversion - the sim applies the power before the parity Niche roll (combat.py:152-153) and the game after it, but of the constructor-applied power classes only IllusionPower reads max_hp and only inside revive() (powers.py:1581), never at apply time, and MinionPower 1 (KinFollower.cs:101, a 1m literal with no ascension branch) is a flat constant; (c) roll ordering - KinFollower is a hand-rolled port with no state machine and no MonsterAi draw at all, so there is no first roll to order against the power (executed: `monster_probes_b02.py seq` shows 0 MonsterAi draws over 40 turns for both the plain and the StartsWithDance configuration). All cited files are carried in this record's extra_sources. NOTE (tooling defect this batch found): `py audit/tools/monster_probes.py ctor-order` does NOT list this unit. Its `_CTOR` regex (the `_CTOR` regex in audit/tools/monster_probes.py, which this pipeline deliberately never hashes) is `def __init__\(self`, which cannot match a port whose signature wraps as `def __init__(<newline> self,`. Reproduce with `py audit/tools/monster_probes_b02.py ctor-regex`: the real population is 46, not the 35 SHARED-FINDINGS section 2 reports, and 11 units are missing from that list.
